title: What I can do now
lead: Colour a circle when you can do the line without help. Come back to this page at the end of every term.

rows.name: Moving Well
rows.can_do: I can walk, run, stop and hop on a line.

rows.name: Understanding Movement
rows.can_do: I can watch a shape and copy it, and I know the words for my body.

rows.name: Moving Creatively
rows.can_do: I can make a new shape, and move like the weather.

rows.name: Taking Part
rows.can_do: I can join a game, take a job in it, and lead one turn.

rows.name: Taking Responsibility
rows.can_do: I can share the kit, carry it safely and use kind words.

rows.name: Healthy Bodies
rows.can_do: I can feel my heart and my breath, and I know when to rest.

title: Show me
lead: Six moves. Look at the words, then show the class.

cards.head: Standing ready
cards.body: Feet apart, eyes ahead, hands still. This is how every move starts.

cards.head: Walking a line
cards.body: Quiet feet, one in front of the other, looking where you go.

cards.head: Stopping
cards.body: Feet side by side, still, on the word. No extra steps.

cards.head: Hopping
cards.body: One foot, small hops, the other foot ready to take over.

cards.head: Throwing
cards.body: Step, look at the target, send the ball, follow with your hand.

cards.head: Finishing
cards.body: Slow breath, kit away, tell your partner one thing that went well.

title: If the class gets stuck
lead: One line each, for the adult in the hall. These are the things worth saying out loud.

cards.head: They will not stop on the word
cards.body: Clap instead of saying it. Feet stop on the clap, and the clap is easier to hear in a hall.

cards.head: Too many children, too little space
cards.body: Half the class moves, half watches with a job in mind. Then swap. The watchers are working too.

cards.head: A child will not join in
cards.body: Give them one job - collector, holder of the cone - and no other words. The job is the invitation.

cards.head: Someone is always first
cards.body: Change the line-up every lesson, and name the child who waited well, not the child who won.

title: Well tried
lead: You moved, you watched, you took turns, and you looked after each other. That is the whole of it.

cards.head: Keep going
cards.body: Walking, running, hopping, skipping - the meadow is always there tomorrow.

cards.head: Keep asking
cards.body: What does my body do when I move? You will have better answers next year.

cards.head: Keep the meadow
cards.body: Kit away, chalk washed off, doors closed. The next class deserves it as you found it.
